Chart IQ read the last bar: popped out of a tightening pullback, over the 10/20 EMA and the last 5 highs on 2.6x volume. Next: buy the first EMA crossback (pullback to the 10/20 EMA that holds). From the brain, Oliver Kell: "'The most beneficial time to get involved.' You know exactly what comes next (EMA Crossback, then Base N' Break) so the risk/reward is highest."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."

lesson_text: Wedge drop: after at least 8 of the last 10 closes over the 20-day EMA, a close under both the 10 and 20-day EMA and under the last 3 lows, in the bottom 40% of its range. Chart IQ read the last bar: lost the 10 and 20 EMA (and the last 3 lows) after a run over them. Next: stay out; wait for a reversal extension and a new wedge pop. The cycle runs Reversal extension, Wedge pop, EMA crossback, Base n' break, Exhaustion extension, Wedge drop, then around again. From the brain, Oliver Kell: "RED LIGHT (Below 20 EMA): Stay in CASH. Do not fight the tape."
